punchline: The coach of Silicon Valley's founders says he began as a great Diminisher.
thirty_sec: According to Liz Wiseman, Bill Campbell said he began as a micromanager until a team member confronted him. He changed, and later coached founders such as Bezos, Page and Brin to draw on their teams.
question: Which of your habits would a trusted teammate name first?
key_contrast: A habit someone named out loud, not a flash of genius.
